about.en:
The National Selection Process of EYP Germany is a three-stage competition that has run since 1990. In the first round, teams of 4-8 young people or individuals aged 15-19 submit a topic outline in English on the 2027 theme (the online generation and digital spaces). A jury of more than 60 people, including Members of the European Parliament, invites the best 22 delegations and 24 individual delegates to Regional Selection Conferences.

The Regional Selection Conferences take place in Munich (10-13 February 2027) and Berlin (21-24 March 2027), each with about 150 young people from all over Europe; the best go on to the National Selection Conference in Leipzig (3-8 June 2027). Winners represent Germany at an EYP International Session. Sessions simulate the European Parliament: teambuilding, committee work on a resolution and a General Assembly debate, plus cultural programme.

The written round is open to young people living in or attending school in Germany. Young people from other countries join these sessions through their own EYP national committee or as volunteer officials (chairs, media, organisers) via the EYP Members Platform.

en: Three-stage competition judged by a jury including MEPs
Regional conferences in Munich and Berlin, national final in Leipzig
Winners go to an EYP International Session abroad

eligibility.en: Young people aged 15-19 (delegations of 4-8, max one delegation per school, or individuals) who attend school/live in Germany; sessions are in English. International students join via their own EYP national committee.

en: Read the 2027 guide and selection topic on the EYP Germany page
Write a topic outline in English using the template
Submit it through the online application form by 11 November 2026
If invited, attend a Regional Selection Conference in February or March 2027

costs.en: Application is free; participation fees and travel for the conferences are set by EYP Germany (contact mitmachen@eyp.de).

score_reason: Prestigious, well-structured competition, but written round for Germany-based students; deadline in 11 days.

about.en:
Leeuwarden 2027 is one of four Regional Conferences in the 2026-27 season of EYP the Netherlands, held 15-17 January 2027 under the theme "Reimagining Europe Together: Innovation is Key". Friday is the officials' training; Saturday is teambuilding and committee work; Sunday is the General Assembly, where committees debate their resolutions in English following European Parliament procedure.

Delegates are Dutch high-school students (havo/vwo, about 15-18) who sign up as a school delegation or individually; the best delegations are selected for the National Conference in Amsterdam in spring 2027. Officials (chairpersons, editors, journalists, organisers) are EYP alumni from all over Europe who apply through calls on the international EYP Members Platform; the event page has travel information for international participants.

It is a short, low-cost way to practise debating, policy writing and public speaking in English and to meet young Europeans.

about.en:
The University Forum is EYP Spain's first session designed for university-age participants. Over three days at Universitat Pompeu Fabra (13-15 November 2026) participants join a committee built around a real European Parliament portfolio, debate a pressing European or global issue, draft a resolution and defend it in a General Assembly vote.

Day 1 brings an opening ceremony and an expert panel, day 2 committee work and a gala night, day 3 the General Assembly. The only requirement is being 18 or older; no experience with EYP or formal debate is needed, so it is a good first step for international students in Barcelona or anyone who can travel there.

about.en:
The Maritime International Forum (MIF) is EYP Spain's first event of this scale in five years: a week of committee work, expert input and a General Assembly focused on marine sustainability, Mediterranean protection and the future of Europe's coastlines. It runs 21-28 April 2027 in Castellón and Valencia with about 120 delegates and 50 volunteers from more than 30 countries.

Delegates come through EYP national committees across Europe (including Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Ukraine and Türkiye where committees are active), usually after national selection sessions; experienced EYP alumni can apply as chairs, journalists or organisers when calls open on the EYP Members Platform. Ask your national committee early if you want a delegate place.

about.en:
EYP Switzerland's 2027 Regional Cycle has three Regional Selection Conferences: Schaffhausen (5-7 March), Fribourg (20-21 March) and Bern (3-4 April). This record covers the Schaffhausen session (5-7 March 2027). Delegates work in committees on current European issues, write a resolution and debate it in a General Assembly, all in English; everyone is welcome regardless of English level.

Only ELSA members and alumni aged 18+ can apply; ELSA has national groups in 40+ countries including Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Ukraine and Türkiye.

about.en:
This Academy at the University of Parma's Department of Economics and Management (9-10 September 2027) covers how AI works, data management and ethical issues on day one, and applications in business on day two: group design challenges on data analysis, content production and innovation, ethical-dilemma role plays and discussions with companies, cooperatives, IT firms and labour representatives.

Outputs feed into a Responsible AI Manifesto for Parma European Youth Capital 2027. In English; registration opens 20 November 2026; 10 mobility grants for participants from outside Parma.

about.en:
StartHER supports female students, PhD candidates, researchers and young entrepreneurs under 35 in developing a business project, with a focus on closing the gender gap in entrepreneurship. Over three days (13-15 April 2027) it combines lectures on the economic, financial and communication sides of starting a business with a practical lab using Design Thinking, Business Model Canvas and Lean Canvas, supported by mentors.

Participants pitch to a technical committee; the strongest projects are showcased at PURE - Parma University Research & Entrepreneurship. Registration opens 20 November 2026; 15 mobility grants for participants from outside Parma. Check the page for working language.
